newsitem.title: USA: AGA says U.S. weekly natgas stocks fell 45 bcf.
newsitem.headline: AGA says U.S. weekly natgas stocks fell 45 bcf.

text.p: estimates of U.S. working gas in storage in billion cubic feet

Notes: (1) Incl Texas, Okla., Kansas, N.Mexico, Arkansas, Louisiana, and Miss. (2) Incl states east of Miss. River less Miss., plus Iowa, Neb and Missouri (3) Incl states west of the Miss. River less producing region and Iowa, Neb and Missouri.
Survey sample and full working gas estimates
- Survey Sample Est. Full Work- Yr-Ago

(4)This percentage value describes the survey sample size each week (sample may change if companies fail to report or a company is added to the weekly survey). It is determined by dividing the maximum volume held in recent years in reported pools for all the reporting companies in a given region for that week by that regions estimated full. Any additions to the sample or failures to report are reflected in a percentage change from the prior week.
(6)This Week regional and Total U.S. volumes divided by Estimated Full regional and Total U.S. volumes. This statistic is intended to show how "full" working gas is at any given time.

*For the 1996-97 winter heating season, 6 Bcf of base gas was withdrawn from Producing Region storage. In addition to the 14 Bcf net refill for this week in the Producing Region, 2 Bcf was injected to base gas leaving a net of 4 Bcf of base gas to be refilled.
